metadata.case_name: TSE YIM KWONG v. MAK YUK KOI AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_after: casual odd-job worker (plastics factory); later unemployed

injuries.description: severe burn injuries following an explosion and fire in the restaurant ... The Plaintiff was admitted to Princess Margaret Hospital on 20th June, 1984 with burns over 12% of his body on both hands and forearm and his face.
source: The Plaintiff sustained severe burn injuries following an explosion and fire in the restaurant where he was employed as a waiter on 20th June, 1984.
Dr. Yip in his report confirmed that the Plaintiff was admitted to Princess Margaret Hospital on 20th June, 1984 with burns over 12% of his body on both hands and forearm and his face.

injuries.description: hypertrophic scar and scar contracture of little fingers requiring reconstructive surgery; reconstructive surgery for scar contracture was carried out over both little fingers on 21st July, 1986.
source: Dr. Yip ... that he was fitted with a pressure garment for the hypertrophic scar which developed and that he received physiotherapy for stiffness of his left wrist and fingers.
Dr. Ho ... reconstructive surgery for scar contracture was carried out over both little fingers on 21st July, 1986.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the wrist or hand

manifestations.description: mild limitation of function in both little fingers
stiffness, weakness and discomfort in his hands
stiffness of his left wrist and fingers

treatments_received: debridement and skin grafting operations of both forearms and hands on 26th and 30th June, 1984 and 4th July, 1984
fitted with a pressure garment for the hypertrophic scar
physiotherapy for stiffness of left wrist and fingers
injection for keloid (pressure garment and injection given for more than a year)
reconstructive surgery for scar contracture on 21st July, 1986

losses.description: permanent and serious cosmetic disability causing embarrassment, people stare at his ugly scars, avoids attending banquets, wears long sleeves to cover scars, affects dining situations

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: does not go swimming in summer because of scars
scars diminish prospects for successful employment as a waiter; can only do low class jobs such as casual worker; potential employers doubt his ability when they see his scars
after discharge he was barely able to look after himself and needed others to assist him cooking meals, cleaning and washing his clothes
